_how_to_add: Each org enables its own ShelterLuv API: ShelterLuv account → Settings → API → generate key. Put the key in shelterluv_keys.json (gitignored) under this org's id, OR set the env var named in key_env. No key = org skipped. The key identifies the org; slug (if set) builds per-cat adoption links. Add a new org = append a block here with its real geocode. Confirmed-ShelterLuv orgs seeded below; expand SoCal → NorCal → nationwide as you obtain keys (see adapters/README.md for the candidate roadmap).
